description: What the account-separation suite must notice (it runs only as root on Linux): every flag of the real launcher (privileges, capabilities, groups, resource limits, environment), the reaper, the owner and mode of every folder the supervisor prepares, the rules for the three accounts, and each of the twelve checks of the start-up proof. A proof that cannot fail proves nothing.

mutations.name: X01-no-new-privs
mutations.what: the agent's commands may gain privileges (no_new_privs dropped)

mutations.name: X02-inh-caps
mutations.what: inheritable capabilities are kept

mutations.name: X03-bounding-set
mutations.what: the bounding capability set is kept

mutations.name: X04-pdeathsig
mutations.what: a command is not killed when the broker dies

mutations.name: X05-groups-lost
mutations.what: the agent loses the shared workspace group

mutations.name: X06-groups-root
mutations.what: the agent keeps root's group

mutations.name: X07-nproc
mutations.what: no process limit

mutations.name: X08-nofile
mutations.what: no limit on open files

mutations.name: X09-fsize
mutations.what: no limit on file size

mutations.name: X10-core
mutations.what: core dumps allowed

mutations.name: X11-data
mutations.what: the memory limit is never applied

mutations.name: X12-env-clean
mutations.what: the environment is not cleared
mutations.equivalent: the launcher starts prlimit with an environment that holds only PATH, so there is nothing left for -i to clear; the flag stays so that a later change of that environment cannot reach the agent's program

mutations.name: X13-reap-kill
mutations.what: the reaper does not kill

patches.old: try { process.kill(pid, 'SIGKILL'); killed.add(pid); } catch { /* gone already */ }

mutations.name: X14-reap-uids
mutations.what: the reaper only looks at the real uid

mutations.name: X15-socket-owner
mutations.what: the socket is not handed to the hub's group

mutations.name: F01-workspaces-mode
mutations.what: the agent can write in the workspaces folder

mutations.name: F02-state-mode
mutations.what: the state folder is readable by others

patches.old: await ensureDirectory(paths.state, { uid: hub.uid, gid: hub.gid, mode: 0o700 });
patches.new: await ensureDirectory(paths.state, { uid: hub.uid, gid: hub.gid, mode: 0o755 });

mutations.name: F03-socketdir-mode
mutations.what: the broker's folder is open to everyone

patches.old: await ensureDirectory(paths.socketDir, { uid: 0, gid: hub.gid, mode: 0o750 });
patches.new: await ensureDirectory(paths.socketDir, { uid: 0, gid: hub.gid, mode: 0o777 });

mutations.name: F04-hooks-mode
mutations.what: the empty hooks folder can be filled by anyone

mutations.name: F05-hooks-owner
mutations.what: the hooks folder is left to its previous owner

mutations.name: F06-hooks-content
mutations.what: a hooks folder with content is taken over

patches.old: if ((await fs.readdir(directory)).length) throw new Error(`${directory} phải là thư mục rỗng (đang dùng làm core.hooksPath)`);

mutations.name: F07-hooks-link
mutations.what: a link is accepted as the hooks folder

patches.old: if (!existing.isDirectory()) throw new Error(`${directory} không phải thư mục thường`);

mutations.name: F08-gitconfig-old
mutations.what: an old .gitconfig of the agent is kept

patches.old:
await fs.rm(target, { force: true });
  const handle

mutations.name: F09-agenthome
mutations.what: the agent's home is open to others

patches.old: await ensureDirectory(paths.agentHome, { uid: agent.uid, gid: agent.gid, mode: 0o700 });
patches.new: await ensureDirectory(paths.agentHome, { uid: agent.uid, gid: agent.gid, mode: 0o777 });

mutations.name: F10-gitconfig-mode
mutations.what: the .gitconfig is writable by others

mutations.name: A01-same-account
mutations.what: hub and agent can be the same account

patches.old: if (hub.uid === agent.uid) problems.push('hub và agent phải là hai tài khoản khác nhau');

mutations.name: A02-root
mutations.what: root can be the agent

patches.old: if (hub.uid === 0 || agent.uid === 0 || hub.gid === 0 || agent.gid === 0 || wsGid === 0) problems.push('hub/agent/ws không được là root');

mutations.name: A03-shared-group
mutations.what: hub and agent can share a primary group

mutations.name: A04-agent-ws-group
mutations.what: the agent's primary group can be the workspace group

mutations.name: Q01-agent-uid
mutations.what: the proof does not check the agent's uid

mutations.name: Q02-groups-hub
mutations.what: the proof accepts the hub's group

mutations.name: Q03-groups-root
mutations.what: the proof accepts root's group

mutations.name: Q04-capbnd
mutations.what: the proof does not look at the bounding set

mutations.name: Q05-capeff
mutations.what: the proof does not look at the effective set

mutations.name: Q06-nnp
mutations.what: the proof does not check no_new_privs

mutations.name: Q07-umask
mutations.what: the proof accepts any umask

mutations.name: Q08-environ
mutations.what: the proof does not try to read the hub's environment

mutations.name: Q09-signal
mutations.what: the proof does not try to signal the hub

mutations.name: Q10-state
mutations.what: the proof does not try to list the state folder

mutations.name: Q11-wsroot
mutations.what: the proof does not try to write in the workspaces folder

mutations.name: Q12-socket
mutations.what: the proof does not try to open the broker socket

mutations.name: Q13-home
mutations.what: the proof does not check the agent's home

mutations.name: Q14-ran
mutations.what: the proof passes when the probe did not run to its end

mutations.name: Q15-all
mutations.what: the proof passes when a check failed
